title: Fail-closed audit hook replaces the response with 503 after the mutation has already committed
test_evidence: cd apps/api-gateway && vitest run src/gw-mix1-audit-precheck.test.ts src/mutation-audit.test.ts (20 passed, exit 0); failing-first: with app.ts onSend temporarily reverted to rewrite-to-503 the new test fails 'expected 503 to be 201' (exit 1), mutation discarded; tsc --noEmit exit 0
notes: Source behaviour already at tip (PR #543): preHandler refuses sensitive mutations with 503 before the handler when audit is down; onSend keeps the committed status, sets x-audit-status: deferred + x-audit-request-id, enqueues a bounded retry and trips the gate. This batch adds the missing HTTP-level regression test (201 + deferred headers, recordAudit attempted, next sensitive write 503 AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE retry-after 5). app.ts unchanged. Residual (not in finding scope): retry queue is in-process and lost on restart; exhausted retries are logged for manual reconciliation; no durable outbox.

title: CDN url-builder does not sanitise '..' or tenantId; nginx purge concatenates baseUrl + caller path
test_evidence: cd packages/shared/cdn && vitest run (75 passed, exit 0); failing-first: 18 new tests failed before the source change (nothing thrown / purge success:true, exit 1); tsc --noEmit exit 0
notes: buildAssetUrl fails closed with CdnPathError (code CDN_INVALID_PATH) when tenantId is not ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$ or the path has a segment that is or percent-decodes to '.'/'..', an encoded separator, a backslash, control characters or a malformed escape. Nginx invalidate rejects unsafe purge paths with success:false (existing result shape), strips the baseUrl trailing slash and normalises the path. New exports are additive. Property generator narrowed to exclude exact '.'/'..' segments (now invalid by definition) plus a new traversal-rejection property. Behaviour change: callers passing such paths/tenant ids now get an exception; no runtime importer of @proctira/cdn found (packages/backend/install declares it but src has no import). Real nginx PURGE is a placeholder in the adapter, not verified. CloudFront invalidation prefixing untouched.
